newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE nearby white sugar ends day softer.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE nearby white sugar ends day softer.

text.p: Nearby white sugar futures finished weaker on Wednesday, pulling back further from Monday's peak.
March finished $1.30 weaker at $306.90 per tonne after trading between $306.60 and $309.00.
The nearby contract peaked at $312.80 on Monday after rallying for a month from December's trough of $295.10.
Wednesday's modest turnover of 1,205 lots was boosted by crossed-against-actuals trades, market sources said.
May ended $1.10 weaker at $306.00 after holding in a range of $306.00 to $307.80.
In Paris, March was $1.00 softer at $307.70 and May 90 cents down at $307.30. Volume was 327 lots.
